name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: Teaches an AI assistant to draw good-looking diagrams (flowcharts, org charts, timelines, architecture maps) that look like a designer made them, instead of the generic boxes-and-arrows AI usually produces.
buyer: A content marketer or technical writer at a startup who needs polished diagrams for blog posts and pitch decks but has no budget for a designer or Figma time.
business_use_cases: A startup's content team generates on-brand architecture and flow diagrams for blog posts and docs without hiring a designer.
A pitch-deck freelancer uses it to produce clean comparison/quadrant/timeline visuals for client decks in minutes instead of fighting with Figma.
An agency offers 'instant editorial diagrams' as an add-on service for technical content clients, using the skill to turn a client's rough notes into a finished visual fast.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you diagram service for startups' blog/docs/decks, charging per diagram or per package.
Sell a branded version of the skill pre-tuned to a client's visual identity as a one-time setup fee.

steal_this: This weekend, offer to redo one SaaS company's three worst-looking blog diagrams for free as a portfolio piece, then pitch a paid monthly diagram-refresh retainer.
